---
title: "Projects"
---

ÇAHSPAR’s project agenda centres on international collaboration and comparative research in working life and social policy. We aim to develop projects that connect well-defined scientific questions with the needs of workers, communities and institutions in different settings.

## Priority Themes

- Decent work, employment quality, labour institutions and social dialogue
- Social protection systems, poverty, inequality and welfare across the life course
- Gender equality, care and participation in working life
- Migration, labour mobility and social inclusion
- Youth transitions, vocational education and changing skills needs
- Digitalisation, artificial intelligence and the future of work
- Just transitions, social entrepreneurship and sustainable livelihoods

## Developing International Projects

We seek partners among universities, research institutes, international associations, public bodies, social partners and civil society organisations. Joint proposals may combine comparative data analysis, field research, policy evaluation, training and knowledge exchange.

Each project will set out its research question, participating institutions, country coverage, methods and intended outputs. The ILO’s five broad regions provide a reference for comparative design; the selection of countries will depend on the question, access to evidence and the expertise of partners.

## Research Quality and Shared Value

We aim to build equitable consortia with clear responsibilities, ethical research procedures and fair recognition of contributions. Outputs may include academic articles, comparative reports, policy briefs, methodological resources and workshops with relevant stakeholders.

Project updates will distinguish proposals, ongoing work and completed results. We seek both to strengthen Türkiye’s participation in international research and to develop knowledge with relevance across countries.
